projects.name: Vanriver
projects.description:
The facade is inspired by the image of a marble quarry: the first and last floors are formed by ledges, mimicking layers of rock. The color uniformity with accent inserts is reminiscent of a marble cross-section. Materials seamlessly transition from the facade into the courtyard and interior, creating a unified composition.
The building maintains the urban line of Malyy Prospekt, harmoniously fitting in between its historic neighbors. The lower part of the facade forms the urban front, while the strict grid echoes the proportions of the surrounding architecture, weaving it into a cohesive urban fabric.
The facade is modern and minimalist, highlighting the historical context while maintaining architectural authenticity.

projects.name: Vanriver.Interiors
projects.description:
The new volume is embedded into the dense historical fabric like a stone sculpture. The project's image was inspired by a marble quarry, where geometric slabs are carved from a solid foundation. The first and last floors recede in tiers, resembling layers of rock. The uniform color scheme with accent inserts evokes the look of a marble cross-section.
This leitmotif flows into the interiors and the courtyard, where the facade material seamlessly transitions inside the building and into the landscaping. Volumetric cuts shape planters for greenery. A strict orthogonal pattern forms a labyrinth of pathways, while stone layers emphasize the natural level changes.

projects.name: Sydney Prime
projects.description:
The project aimed to create a residential neighborhood with living conditions focused on comfort, harmony of the internal space, and well-developed infrastructure.
The building’s form both supports and shapes the urban lines of the embankment, creating an open and transparent environment. The architectural design eliminates the "window-to-window" effect, ensuring that all apartments, without exception, have a view of the water.
The facades are designed in a calm, minimalist aesthetic, seamlessly blending into the surrounding environment. The three-part composition of the building is shaped by the urban context and the influence of the river.

projects.name: Petrovskiy Park. 2
projects.description:
The competition project for the redevelopment of the former "Vimpel" factory reinterprets its industrial heritage. The main idea is a silhouetted residential development that creates an expressive rhythm within the urban environment.
The industrial-style facade combines white composite materials and brick masonry, creating a balance between modern aesthetics and the industrial past. The contrast of textures enhances the depth of the facade, giving the building a dynamic and strict character.
The project is integrated into the historical context, preserving the spirit of the place while imbuing it with new meaning.

projects.name: Breatec.Office
projects.description:
The office project is not just a workspace but a place that reflects our company's values and culture. We have created an environment focused on employee comfort, where work and social areas complement each other harmoniously.
The office serves as both a productive workspace and a hub for our community, fostering collaboration and growth. A multifunctional area allows for events, meetings, and relaxation, creating a vibrant and dynamic atmosphere.
The architectural design highlights our identity, shaping a space where people feel inspired to work and develop.

projects.name: Botanicheskaya 34
projects.description:
The project is located in Kazan on Botanicheskaya Street, near the city center. The facade solutions were developed by GAFA architectural bureau, while our team was responsible for the interior layouts, creating a comfortable and functional space.
This Comfort+ class residential complex combines thoughtful architecture with a well-designed living environment. A looped underground parking lot for 395 cars ensures convenient entry and exit. The spacious grand lobby and vestibules with waiting areas, stroller storage, and restrooms provide a comfortable space for residents.

projects.name: Botanicheskaya 34. Interiors
projects.description:
The interior project on Botanicheskaya Street in Kazan reflects the harmony of water, stone, and wood, creating a space filled with the natural plasticity of organic materials. The inspiration came from the river—its movement, depth, and reflections—which are echoed in the textures and colors of the interior.
Natural materials are used in the finishes: the warm tones of wood soften the coolness of stone, creating a balanced tactile experience. Smooth forms and flowing lines within the space embody the essence of water—lightness, fluidity, and natural harmony.

projects.name: Hadi Taktasha
projects.description:
The project is located in Kazan on Khadi Taktasha Street. The facade solutions were developed by the WALL architectural bureau, while our team was responsible for the interior planning, creating a space that combines functionality and comfort.
This business-class residential complex features thoughtful architecture. The underground parking lot, designed for 550 cars, includes looped driveways, ensuring convenient and efficient access to parking spaces.
The ground floors feature spacious entrance lobbies with waiting areas and restrooms, providing a comfortable environment for residents. On the upper floors, the apartments gradually decrease in depth, transitioning into larger layouts at the top levels.

projects.name: Shkiperskiy 19
projects.description: Residential complex offering unique views of the Galerny Basin and the Baltic Sea. Each apartment features panoramic views, allowing residents to enjoy picturesque vistas of the water landscapes.

projects.name: Zarechniy Park
projects.process: concept, stage PD, AUPS, stage WD
projects.description: Two massing forms within a large mixed-use development are located at the border of St. Petersburg and Leningrad Region. Our team developed the concept, project documentation, and working drawings.
